title: Bootstrap pytest for a Flask project
prompt: Set up a pytest configuration for a Flask application, add smoke and route tests, and keep the test suite fast and focused on real behavior.
when_to_use: When creating or expanding a Flask project and you need a reliable automated test foundation.
watch_out_for: Avoid mocking the Flask app when a real test client can verify routes and JSON responses.

title: Generate a uniquely-solvable Sudoku puzzle
prompt: Build a Sudoku generator that creates a full valid board, removes cells one by one, and only keeps removals when the puzzle still has exactly one solution.
when_to_use: When implementing puzzle generation that must preserve a unique solution.
watch_out_for: Do not stop after a single pass; validate uniqueness after each carve attempt to avoid ambiguous puzzles.

title: Top 10 leaderboard in localStorage
prompt: Create a simple Top 10 leaderboard stored in localStorage with add, render, and clear actions.
when_to_use: When the app needs a lightweight local score board without a backend.
watch_out_for: Keep the data shape stable and cap entries to 10 so the UI stays predictable.

title: Alternating 3x3 square CSS
prompt: Style a 9x9 Sudoku board so the 3x3 boxes alternate background colors while retaining accessible contrast.
when_to_use: When building the board visual grid and you want a polished, readable layout.
watch_out_for: Use CSS custom properties rather than hard-coded colors to keep theming consistent.

title: Hint button that fills and locks one cell
prompt: Add a hint button that reveals one empty cell, applies the value locally, and marks the cell as locked so it cannot be overwritten.
when_to_use: When the UI needs a hint mechanic that is stateless and client-side.
watch_out_for: Do not add server-side hint state; treat hints as a local visual effect and keep the cell locked.

title: Rejected suggestion: stateful server-side game session
prompt: Suggest a stateful server-side game session for the Sudoku app, then reject it and document why a stateless design is better.
when_to_use: When a design suggestion would add unnecessary server state and complexity.
watch_out_for: Include the rejected prompt, why it was rejected, and the lesson learned in the reusable template.
